acceptanceCriteria: The matrix row names the runtime the host actually uses, the conformance test accepts it, and the owner decides whether JS host tests also run under Bun.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 OpenCode 2 port (adapter 0.3.0) during the rc.2 adapter audit. integrations/compatibility.json opencode hostForcedRuntime is node >=20 and the conformance test requires node, but OpenCode 2 loads plugins in its embedded Bun (1.4.2 in 2.0.18); see decision 0059. The live run passed under Bun, while the JS host tests run under node. Decide the declared runtime and whether the fixture tests should also run under Bun.
title: OpenCode matrix row claims a node runtime but OpenCode 2 runs plugins in embedded Bun
